blocks.zh: Subpart C：申辦人責任：修改申請、年度報告與安全性報告
blocks.en: Subpart C: Sponsor Responsibilities: Amendments, Annual Reports and Safety Reporting

blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 識別三類協議修改（protocol amendments）的觸發條件，區分「需 FDA 30 天預先批准」與「30 天內通知」的情境
blocks.en: Identify the triggers for the three types of protocol amendment, and distinguish situations that require FDA's 30-day wait from those that only require notification within 30 days

blocks.zh: 理解 §312.31 資訊修改（information amendments）的適用範圍，包括 CMC 變更觸發條件與 CDMO 的通知義務
blocks.en: Understand the scope of information amendments under §312.31, including CMC change triggers and the CDMO's duty to notify the sponsor

blocks.zh: 深入掌握 §312.32 IND 安全報告機制：SUSAR 定義、7 天與 15 天快速報告時間軸、報告內容要素，以及 CDMO 在安全評估中的角色與邊界
blocks.en: Master the IND safety reporting mechanism under §312.32: the SUSAR definition, the 7-day and 15-day expedited reporting timelines, the required report content, and the role and limits of the CDMO in safety assessment

blocks.zh: 熟悉 §312.33 年度報告的結構要求（六大必備項目）與遞交期限（IND 生效日週年後 60 天內）
blocks.en: Know the structure of the annual report under §312.33 (six required elements) and its submission deadline (within 60 days of the anniversary of the IND effective date)

blocks.zh: 建立安全報告決策樹：面對任何不良事件，能快速分類適用的報告類型與時限
blocks.en: Build a safety reporting decision tree: for any adverse event, quickly classify the applicable report type and timeline

blocks.zh: 識別 FDA 查廠常見 483 觀察項目：未遞交 7 天報告、CMC 變更未提交資訊修改等
blocks.en: Recognize common FDA Form 483 observations at inspection: failure to submit 7-day reports, CMC changes not submitted as information amendments, and similar findings

blocks.zh: 本章涵蓋範圍 Coverage
blocks.en: Coverage

blocks.zh: 3.1 §312.30 — Protocol Amendments 協議修改申請
blocks.en: 3.1 §312.30 — Protocol Amendments

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 三類協議修改的核心邏輯 Three Types of Protocol Amendments
blocks.en: Three Types of Protocol Amendments

blocks.zh: §312.30 的核心問題是：「這個變更是否會影響受試者安全、研究範疇或科學品質？」 如果是，就需要提交協議修改。
blocks.en: The core question under §312.30 is: "Will this change affect subject safety, the scope of the investigation, or scientific quality?" If so, a protocol amendment must be submitted.

blocks.zh: 實務上可以用三個問題快速篩選：
blocks.en: In practice, three questions give a quick screen:

blocks.zh: 是全新研究？ → 新協議修改（附完整協議文本 + FDA Form 1572）
blocks.en: Is it an entirely new study? → New protocol amendment (with the full protocol text + FDA Form 1572)

blocks.zh: 是更改現有協議中的劑量/時間/族群/設計？ → 協議變更修改（附修訂協議及變更說明）
blocks.en: Is it a change to dose, timing, population or design in an existing protocol? → Change in protocol amendment (with the revised protocol and a description of the change)

blocks.zh: 只是加入新研究員/機構？ → 新研究員修改（附 FDA Form 1572 + CV）
blocks.en: Is it only the addition of a new investigator or site? → New investigator amendment (with FDA Form 1572 + CV)

blocks.zh: 這三類都歸屬於「Protocol Amendments」，不同的只是內容和附件要求。
blocks.en: All three fall under "Protocol Amendments"; what differs is the content and the attachments required.

blocks.zh: Phase 1 vs Phase 2/3 的規則差異
blocks.en: Rule Differences between Phase 1 and Phase 2/3

blocks.zh: §312.30 對不同研究期別設有不同的啟動規則：
blocks.en: §312.30 sets different start rules for different study phases:

blocks.zh: Phase 1：提交新協議後需等待 30 天（FDA 默示批准期），除非 FDA 提前通知可進行。這是因為 Phase 1 本身就是首次人體研究，安全不確定性最高。
blocks.en: Phase 1: After a new protocol is submitted, the sponsor must wait 30 days (FDA's implied approval period) unless FDA notifies the sponsor earlier that the study may proceed. This is because Phase 1 is the first study in humans, where safety uncertainty is highest.

blocks.zh: Phase 2/3：可在提交修改的同日開始，除非收到 Clinical Hold 通知或 FDA 要求等待。
blocks.en: Phase 2/3: The study may begin on the same day the amendment is submitted, unless a clinical hold notice is received or FDA requests that the sponsor wait.

blocks.zh: 實務警示：許多申辦人誤以為所有協議修改都需等待 30 天。事實上只有 Phase 1 的新協議和顯著增加風險的變更才適用 30 天等待期。
blocks.en: Practical warning: many sponsors wrongly assume that every protocol amendment requires a 30-day wait. In fact, the 30-day waiting period applies only to new Phase 1 protocols and to changes that significantly increase risk.

blocks.zh: 新研究員修改 — CDMO 場景 New Investigator Amendment in CDMO Context
blocks.en: New Investigator Amendment in CDMO Context

blocks.zh: 當多中心臨床試驗新增研究機構時，申辦人必須在受試者入組前提交新研究員修改。每位新研究員都需要：
blocks.en: When a multicenter clinical trial adds a study site, the sponsor must submit a new investigator amendment before subjects are enrolled. Each new investigator needs:

blocks.zh: 已簽署的 FDA Form 1572（Statement of Investigator，研究員承諾書）
blocks.en: A signed FDA Form 1572 (Statement of Investigator, the investigator's undertaking)

blocks.zh: 研究員的 CV（確認資格與相關經驗）
blocks.en: The investigator's CV (to confirm qualifications and relevant experience)

blocks.zh: 機構審查委員會（IRB）批准文件
blocks.en: Institutional Review Board (IRB) approval documents

blocks.zh: CDMO 角色提醒：合約製造商不是研究員，不需簽署 1572。但 CDMO 若涉及臨床試驗物料製造，必須確保其設施資訊已被納入 IND 的 CMC 部分，並在設施或方法有重大變更時知會申辦人。
blocks.en: CDMO role reminder: a contract manufacturer is not an investigator and does not sign Form 1572. However, a CDMO that manufactures clinical trial material must ensure that its facility information is covered in the CMC section of the IND, and must inform the sponsor of any significant change to the facility or methods.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Quick Classification
blocks.en: Quick Classification

blocks.zh: 判斷以下情境屬於哪類協議修改，是否需等待 FDA 批准：
blocks.en: Decide which type of protocol amendment applies to each situation below, and whether FDA's clearance must be awaited:

blocks.zh: Phase 1 IND 下，申辦人想新增一個 Phase 2 劑量確認研究（新適應症，同一藥物）
blocks.en: Under a Phase 1 IND, the sponsor wants to add a Phase 2 dose-confirmation study (new indication, same drug)

blocks.zh: 現有 Phase 3 研究中，更改主要終點的評估時間從 6 個月延長到 9 個月（原因：觀察到治療效果出現較慢）
blocks.en: In an ongoing Phase 3 study, the assessment time for the primary endpoint is extended from 6 months to 9 months (reason: the treatment effect was observed to appear more slowly)

blocks.zh: Phase 2 研究新增一個澳洲的臨床試驗機構，由具有豐富專科經驗的研究員主持
blocks.en: A Phase 2 study adds a clinical site in Australia, led by an investigator with extensive specialty experience

blocks.zh: 參考答案在右欄下方
blocks.en: Reference answers are below in the right-hand column

blocks.zh: 答案： (1) 新協議修改，需等 30 天（Phase 1 規則）。(2) 協議變更修改，可立即執行（Phase 3），但需提交說明文件。(3) 新研究員修改，不需等待，但入組前必須已提交。
blocks.en: Answer: (1) New protocol amendment; wait 30 days (Phase 1 rule). (2) Change in protocol amendment; may be implemented immediately (Phase 3), but supporting documentation must be submitted. (3) New investigator amendment; no waiting required, but it must be submitted before enrollment.

blocks.zh: 3.2 §312.31 — Information Amendments 資訊修改申請
blocks.en: 3.2 §312.31 — Information Amendments

blocks.zh: 資訊修改的定位：「其他所有重要資訊的容納槽」
blocks.en: The Role of the Information Amendment: "The Catch-All for Other Important Information"

blocks.zh: §312.31 可以理解為 IND 申請體系的「通用收件槽」——凡是重要且新獲得的資訊，若不屬於協議修改、安全報告或年度報告的範疇，就透過資訊修改遞交給 FDA。
blocks.en: §312.31 can be understood as the "general intake slot" of the IND system: any important, newly obtained information that does not fall under a protocol amendment, a safety report or an annual report is submitted to FDA through an information amendment.

blocks.zh: 資訊修改在實務上最常出現在以下兩大情境：
blocks.en: In practice, information amendments arise most often in two situations:

blocks.zh: CMC 更新：製造商變更、方法變更、設施變更 — 任何可能影響臨床試驗物料品質的製造/分析變更都需要資訊修改
blocks.en: CMC updates: changes of manufacturer, method or facility; any manufacturing or analytical change that may affect the quality of the clinical trial material requires an information amendment

blocks.zh: 非臨床新數據：動物實驗新發現（毒性、藥理）可能影響臨床計畫的安全評估
blocks.en: New nonclinical data: new findings from animal studies (toxicity, pharmacology) that may affect the safety assessment of the clinical program

blocks.zh: CMC 資訊修改 — CDMO 最直接相關的法規義務
blocks.en: CMC Information Amendments — The Regulatory Obligation Most Directly Relevant to CDMOs

blocks.zh: 對合約製造機構（CDMO）而言，§312.31 是最直接相關的條款之一，因為 CMC 變更往往發生在製造端：
blocks.en: For a contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO), §312.31 is one of the most directly relevant provisions, because CMC changes frequently originate on the manufacturing side:

blocks.zh: 製造場址變更：例如原廠 A 生產，改由關係企業或合約工廠 B 生產 → 申辦人需提交資訊修改，更新 IND 的 CMC 章節
blocks.en: Manufacturing site change: for example, production moves from Site A to an affiliate or a contract facility B → the sponsor must submit an information amendment to update the CMC section of the IND

blocks.zh: 分析方法變更：採用新的 HPLC 方法替代舊方法進行效價測試 → 需提交資訊修改並附新方法驗證摘要
blocks.en: Analytical method change: a new HPLC method replaces the old one for potency testing → an information amendment is required, with a summary of the new method's validation

blocks.zh: 滅菌製程變更：修改無菌過濾條件或最終滅菌循環參數 → 需提交資訊修改附驗證數據
blocks.en: Sterilization process change: changes to sterile filtration conditions or terminal sterilization cycle parameters → an information amendment with validation data is required

blocks.zh: 核心原則：CDMO 不是 IND 持有人，不能直接遞交資訊修改。但 CDMO 有義務及時通知申辦人任何影響臨床物料品質的製造或測試變更，使申辦人能在 30 天期限內遞交資訊修改。
blocks.en: Core principle: the CDMO is not the IND holder and cannot submit an information amendment directly. However, the CDMO is obliged to notify the sponsor promptly of any manufacturing or testing change that affects the quality of the clinical material, so that the sponsor can submit the information amendment within the 30-day timeframe.

blocks.zh: 常見 FDA 483：CMC 變更未提交資訊修改
blocks.en: Common FDA 483: CMC Changes Not Submitted as Information Amendments

blocks.zh: FDA 查廠官員在審查 IND 文件與內部記錄時，會特別核查以下問題：
blocks.en: When reviewing IND documents and internal records, FDA investigators specifically check for the following problems:

blocks.zh: 製造記錄顯示批次生產場址已更換，但 FDA 系統中的 IND 資料仍顯示原場址 → 典型 483
blocks.en: Manufacturing records show that the batch production site has changed, but the IND information in FDA's system still shows the original site → a typical 483 observation

blocks.zh: 分析方法變更後的批次已用於臨床試驗，但申辦人未向 FDA 報告方法變更 → 嚴重的資訊申報缺失
blocks.en: Batches made after an analytical method change have been used in clinical trials, but the sponsor has not reported the method change to FDA → a serious information reporting deficiency

blocks.zh: 穩定性試驗新數據顯示貨架期縮短，但 IND 中的有效期仍為原始值 → 可能導致已過期試驗藥品繼續使用於試驗
blocks.en: New stability data show a shortened shelf life, but the IND still states the original expiry period → expired investigational product may continue to be used in the study

blocks.zh: 後果：這類疏失可能導致 FDA 對整個臨床計畫的數據完整性提出質疑，甚至觸發 Clinical Hold。
blocks.en: Consequence: such lapses may lead FDA to question the data integrity of the entire clinical program, and may even trigger a clinical hold.

blocks.zh: 比喻：資訊修改如同建築許可的「變更通知」
blocks.en: Analogy: An Information Amendment Is Like a "Change Notice" on a Building Permit

blocks.zh: 想像建築師獲得了某棟樓的建築許可（類比 IND 批准）。開工後若材料、工法有任何重大變更，都必須通知審查機關（類比 FDA）。資訊修改就像這種「施工變更通知」——不改變整體設計藍圖（不是協議修改），也不是安全事故（不是安全報告），但仍是主管機關需要知道的重要變更。未通知便擅自更改，可能導致整個建築許可被撤銷（類比 IND Clinical Hold）。
blocks.en: Imagine an architect who has obtained a building permit for a building (analogous to IND clearance). After construction starts, any significant change in materials or methods must be notified to the permitting authority (analogous to FDA). An information amendment is like such a "construction change notice": it does not alter the overall design blueprint (so it is not a protocol amendment), and it is not a safety incident (so it is not a safety report), but it is still an important change that the authority needs to know about. Making changes without notification could result in the whole permit being revoked (analogous to an IND clinical hold).

blocks.zh: 3.3 §312.32 — IND Safety Reports（重點章節）IND 安全報告
blocks.en: 3.3 §312.32 — IND Safety Reports (Key Section)

blocks.zh: SUSAR 定義拆解 — 三個條件缺一不可
blocks.en: SUSAR Definition Broken Down: All Three Criteria Must Be Met

blocks.zh: SUSAR（Serious Unexpected Suspected Adverse Reaction，嚴重且非預期的疑似藥物不良反應）必須同時滿足三個條件：
blocks.en: A SUSAR (Serious Unexpected Suspected Adverse Reaction) must meet all three of the following criteria at the same time:

blocks.zh: Serious（嚴重性）：死亡、危及生命、需住院、永久殘疾、先天畸形、或重要醫療事件（任一符合即可）
blocks.en: Serious: death, life-threatening event, hospitalization, persistent disability, congenital anomaly, or an important medical event (any one is sufficient)

blocks.zh: Unexpected（非預期性）：該事件的性質或嚴重程度，在研究員手冊（Investigator's Brochure）中未被列為已知不良反應，或雖有列出但實際發生的嚴重程度比已知描述更嚴重
blocks.en: Unexpected: the nature or severity of the event is not listed as a known adverse reaction in the Investigator's Brochure, or is listed but the severity actually observed is greater than the known description

blocks.zh: Suspected（疑似因果關係）：有合理可能性認為是試驗藥品導致，而非完全由受試者的基礎疾病或其他因素所致
blocks.en: Suspected (causal relationship): there is a reasonable possibility that the investigational product caused the event, rather than it being entirely attributable to the subject's underlying disease or other factors

blocks.zh: 只有同時滿足三個條件，才需提交快速安全報告。若不嚴重（非 SAE）、已預期、或因果關係可排除，則不屬於 SUSAR，只需在年度報告中彙整。
blocks.en: An expedited safety report is required only when all three criteria are met. If the event is not serious (not an SAE), is expected, or a causal relationship can be ruled out, it is not a SUSAR and only needs to be summarized in the annual report.

blocks.zh: 安全報告時間軸決策樹 Safety Report Timeline Decision Tree
blocks.en: Safety Report Timeline Decision Tree

blocks.zh:
收到不良事件資訊
        ↓
是否為 SAE（嚴重不良事件）？
   NO → 不需快速報告，彙整至年度報告
   YES ↓
是否在研究員手冊中「未被預期」？
   NO（已預期）→ 彙整至年度報告（Annual Report）
   YES ↓
是否有合理因果關係（Suspected）？
   NO → 不需快速報告，記錄追蹤
   YES → 確認為 SUSAR，繼續判斷 ↓
是否為「致死或危及生命」？
   YES → 【7-Day Report】
   NO（但仍為 SAE+Unexpected）→ 【15-Day Report】

動物/體外試驗發現顯著人體風險？
（致突變、致畸胎、致癌）
   YES → 【15-Day Report】

後續隨訪調查完成後有新重要資訊？
   YES → 【Follow-up Report（調查完成後 15 天內）】
blocks.en:
Adverse event information received
        ↓
Is it an SAE (serious adverse event)?
   NO → No expedited report; include in the annual report
   YES ↓
Is it "unexpected" per the Investigator's Brochure?
   NO (expected) → Include in the Annual Report
   YES ↓
Is there a reasonable causal relationship (Suspected)?
   NO → No expedited report; document and follow up
   YES → Confirmed as a SUSAR; continue ↓
Is it "fatal or life-threatening"?
   YES → [7-Day Report]
   NO (but still SAE + Unexpected) → [15-Day Report]

Animal/in vitro findings suggesting significant human risk?
(mutagenicity, teratogenicity, carcinogenicity)
   YES → [15-Day Report]

New important information after follow-up investigation is complete?
   YES → [Follow-up Report (within 15 days after the investigation is completed)]

blocks.zh: 「未預期（Unexpected）」的判斷基準詳解
blocks.en: Detailed Criteria for Judging "Unexpected"

blocks.zh: 「未預期」是最容易引起爭議的判斷要素。FDA 的立場是：
blocks.en: "Unexpected" is the element most likely to cause disputes. FDA's position is:

blocks.zh: 判斷基準文件：研究員手冊（Investigator's Brochure, IB）中記載的不良反應資料。若藥物已上市，則以核准仿單（Package Insert / Prescribing Information）為準。
blocks.en: Reference document: the adverse reaction information in the Investigator's Brochure (IB). If the drug is already marketed, the approved labeling (Package Insert / Prescribing Information) applies instead.

blocks.zh: 若 IB 中描述某不良反應為「輕度頭痛（mild headache）」，而受試者出現「嚴重且需住院的頭痛」，則即使「頭痛」這個事件已在 IB 中列出，但因嚴重程度超出 IB 描述，仍視為「未預期」。
blocks.en: If the IB describes an adverse reaction as "mild headache" and a subject experiences "severe headache requiring hospitalization", the event is still regarded as "unexpected" even though "headache" is listed in the IB, because the severity exceeds what the IB describes.

blocks.zh: 當研究員手冊更新後，新的安全資訊被納入 IB，原本「未預期」的反應會轉變為「已預期」，未來類似事件就不再需要快速報告。這是申辦人更新 IB 的重要動機之一。
blocks.en: When the Investigator's Brochure is updated and new safety information is added, a reaction that was previously "unexpected" becomes "expected", and similar events in future no longer require expedited reporting. This is one of the key reasons sponsors update the IB.

blocks.zh: 比喻：安全報告如同航空業的強制事件報告
blocks.en: Analogy: Safety Reporting Is Like Mandatory Occurrence Reporting in Aviation

blocks.zh: 航空業有一套強制事故通報制度：無論飛行員或航空公司是否「有過錯」，某些安全事件（如機械故障、鳥擊、跑道侵入）都必須在規定時間內向監管機關通報。這套制度的目的是系統性安全改善，而非追責。
blocks.en: The aviation industry has a mandatory incident reporting system: regardless of whether the pilot or airline is "at fault", certain safety events (such as mechanical failures, bird strikes and runway incursions) must be reported to the regulator within a set time. The purpose of the system is systematic safety improvement, not assigning blame.

blocks.zh: IND 安全報告的邏輯完全一致：FDA 不是要追究申辦人責任，而是需要即時獲得安全信號，以便在必要時採取保護受試者的監管行動（如發出 Clinical Hold）。因此，申辦人不能因為「認為事件與藥物無關」就延遲或省略報告——若符合 SUSAR 定義，就必須報告，同時在報告中說明因果關係評估意見。
blocks.en: The logic of IND safety reporting is exactly the same: FDA is not trying to hold the sponsor accountable, but needs to receive safety signals promptly so that, where necessary, it can take regulatory action to protect subjects (such as issuing a clinical hold). A sponsor therefore cannot delay or omit a report because it "believes the event is unrelated to the drug"; if the SUSAR definition is met, the event must be reported, and the report should state the sponsor's causality assessment.

blocks.zh: 致命 FDA 483：申辦人未遞交 7 天報告
blocks.en: Fatal FDA 483: Sponsor Failed to Submit a 7-Day Report

blocks.zh: §312.32 是 FDA 臨床調查查廠中被引用頻率最高的條款之一。典型的 483 觀察項目包括：
blocks.en: §312.32 is one of the provisions most frequently cited in FDA clinical investigation inspections. Typical 483 observations include:

blocks.zh:
「Failure to submit 7-day IND safety report for a fatal SUSAR」
情境：申辦人收到受試者死亡報告，判斷為「預期反應（expected）」而未提交 7 天報告。FDA 查廠時發現死亡事件的性質實際上超出 IB 描述，應屬「未預期」，構成應報告的 SUSAR。
blocks.en:
"Failure to submit 7-day IND safety report for a fatal SUSAR"
Scenario: the sponsor received a report of a subject's death, judged it to be an "expected reaction" and did not submit a 7-day report. At inspection, FDA found that the nature of the death actually exceeded the IB description and should have been "unexpected", constituting a reportable SUSAR.

blocks.zh:
「Failure to submit IND safety report within 15 calendar days」
情境：申辦人收到嚴重不良事件報告後，花時間進行內部評估，導致超過 15 天期限才提交報告。
blocks.en:
"Failure to submit IND safety report within 15 calendar days"
Scenario: after receiving a serious adverse event report, the sponsor spent time on internal evaluation, and the report was submitted after the 15-day deadline.

blocks.zh:
「Safety reports lack required causality assessment or lot number information」
情境：提交了安全報告但遺漏批次號碼，或因果關係評估僅一句話未提供科學依據。
blocks.en:
"Safety reports lack required causality assessment or lot number information"
Scenario: a safety report was submitted but omitted the lot number, or the causality assessment was a single sentence with no scientific rationale.

blocks.zh: 後果等級：7 天報告缺失是 FDA 最嚴格對待的違規之一，可能直接觸發 Clinical Hold（臨床暫停令），影響整個開發計畫。
blocks.en: Severity of consequences: a missing 7-day report is among the violations FDA treats most severely and can directly trigger a clinical hold, affecting the entire development program.

blocks.zh: CDMO 在安全報告中的角色與邊界
blocks.en: The CDMO's Role and Boundaries in Safety Reporting

blocks.zh: 這是 CDMO 從業人員最需要理解的邊界問題：
blocks.en: This is the boundary question that CDMO personnel most need to understand:

blocks.zh: CDMO 的核心義務：提供所有製造相關資訊（批號、配方、製程、OOS 調查結果）以支持申辦人的安全評估。CDMO 隱瞞或延遲通報製造問題，可能使申辦人錯過法定報告期限，是嚴重的合規風險。
blocks.en: The CDMO's core obligation: provide all manufacturing-related information (lot numbers, formulation, process, OOS investigation results) to support the sponsor's safety assessment. If a CDMO conceals or delays reporting a manufacturing problem, the sponsor may miss its statutory reporting deadline, which is a serious compliance risk.

blocks.zh: 3.4 §312.33 — Annual Reports 年度報告
blocks.en: 3.4 §312.33 — Annual Reports

blocks.zh: 年度報告的六大必備項目
blocks.en: The Six Required Elements of the Annual Report

blocks.zh: §312.33 年度報告的框架可以記憶為「六大模組」：
blocks.en: The framework of the §312.33 annual report can be remembered as "six modules":

blocks.zh: 個別研究資訊：每個臨床試驗的狀態、入組數、不良事件摘要
blocks.en: Individual study information: status of each clinical trial, number enrolled, and summary of adverse events

blocks.zh: IND 整體狀態與未來計畫：過去一年的進展 + 下一年的研究計畫
blocks.en: Overall IND status and future plans: progress over the past year + the study plan for the coming year

blocks.zh: 協議修改摘要：全年提交的所有協議修改及其原因
blocks.en: Summary of protocol amendments: all protocol amendments submitted during the year and the reasons for them

blocks.zh: 境外市場發展：若藥物已在其他國家上市，需報告境外監管動態
blocks.en: Foreign marketing developments: if the drug is marketed in other countries, report foreign regulatory developments

blocks.zh: CMC 更新：全年製造或測試方法的任何變更，加上最新規格與穩定性數據
blocks.en: CMC updates: any change in manufacturing or test methods during the year, plus the latest specifications and stability data

blocks.zh: 微生物學資料（抗感染藥物）：體外敏感性數據及抗藥性發展資訊
blocks.en: Microbiology data (anti-infective drugs): in vitro susceptibility data and information on the development of resistance

blocks.zh: 年度報告不是快速安全報告——它是一份全年回顧文件，不能取代 7 天或 15 天的即時報告義務。
blocks.en: The annual report is not an expedited safety report: it is a year-end review document and cannot replace the obligation to make 7-day or 15-day reports in real time.

blocks.zh: 年度報告與 IND 生效日 — 時鐘計算
blocks.en: Annual Reports and the IND Effective Date: Calculating the Clock

blocks.zh: §312.33 的截止日是 IND 生效日週年後 60 天。IND 生效日不是 FDA 批准日，而是 FDA 收到 IND 申請後的第 31 天（若未發出臨床暫停令）：
blocks.en: The §312.33 deadline is 60 days after the anniversary of the IND effective date. The IND effective date is not the date of FDA approval; it is the 31st day after FDA receives the IND application (if no clinical hold is issued):

blocks.zh: IND 收件日：例如 2026-04-14
blocks.en: IND received: for example 2026-04-14

blocks.zh: IND 生效日：2026-05-14（若無 Clinical Hold）
blocks.en: IND effective date: 2026-05-14 (if no clinical hold)

blocks.zh: 第一份年度報告截止：2027-07-13（IND 生效後 1 年 + 60 天）
blocks.en: First annual report due: 2027-07-13 (1 year after the IND effective date + 60 days)

blocks.zh: 申辦人必須在內部系統中追蹤 IND 生效日，建立提醒機制，確保不逾期。FDA 的年度報告追蹤系統會主動核查遞交合規性。
blocks.en: The sponsor must track the IND effective date in an internal system and set up reminders to avoid missing the deadline. FDA's annual report tracking system actively checks submission compliance.

blocks.zh: CMC 章節年度更新 — 與 CDMO 的協作義務
blocks.en: Annual CMC Update: Collaboration Obligations with the CDMO

blocks.zh: 年度報告中的 CMC 更新章節，是 CDMO 與申辦人全年溝通成果的彙整。需要包括：
blocks.en: The CMC update section of the annual report consolidates the results of the CDMO's communications with the sponsor throughout the year. It needs to include:

blocks.zh: 本年度所有已提交的資訊修改（§312.31）的摘要
blocks.en: A summary of all information amendments (§312.31) submitted during the year

blocks.zh: 生產場址、製程、測試方法的任何變更
blocks.en: Any changes to production sites, processes and test methods

blocks.zh: 批次製造記錄中的任何重要偏差及調查結果
blocks.en: Any significant deviations in batch manufacturing records and the investigation results

blocks.zh: 最新的藥品或藥物原料穩定性數據，包括任何超趨勢或 OOS 結果
blocks.en: The latest stability data for the drug product or drug substance, including any out-of-trend or OOS results

blocks.zh: 如果 CDMO 在全年未曾將重要製造資訊通知申辦人，申辦人在年度報告截止前可能才發現資訊缺口，導致要麼遞交不完整的年度報告，要麼匆忙提交大量補充資訊修改，兩者都是合規風險。
blocks.en: If the CDMO did not notify the sponsor of important manufacturing information during the year, the sponsor may only discover the information gap shortly before the annual report deadline, and will then either submit an incomplete annual report or hurriedly file a large number of supplementary information amendments. Both are compliance risks.

blocks.zh: 年度報告的常見疏失
blocks.en: Common Annual Report Lapses

blocks.zh: 遺漏已終止研究：某研究雖已停止招募，但仍有受試者在觀察期中，相關不良事件仍需在年度報告中列出
blocks.en: Omitting terminated studies: even if a study has stopped recruiting, if subjects are still in the follow-up period, the related adverse events must still be listed in the annual report

blocks.zh: 安全事件摘要不完整：只列出當年快速報告的 SUSAR，遺漏非 SUSAR 但仍重要的不良事件趨勢
blocks.en: Incomplete safety event summary: listing only the SUSARs reported on an expedited basis during the year, and omitting trends in non-SUSAR adverse events that are still important

blocks.zh: CMC 更新遺漏製造場址變更：若已在 §312.31 提交資訊修改，年度報告中仍需摘要說明，但不能以此為由省略年度 CMC 彙整
blocks.en: CMC update omitting manufacturing site changes: even if an information amendment was already submitted under §312.31, the annual report must still summarize it; this cannot be used as a reason to omit the annual CMC summary

blocks.zh: 未來計畫描述過於模糊：FDA 用年度報告評估臨床開發計畫的合理性；「視情況而定」此類描述可能引發 FDA 詢問函
blocks.en: Vague description of future plans: FDA uses the annual report to assess whether the clinical development plan is reasonable; wording such as "as circumstances require" may prompt an FDA information request

blocks.zh: 3.5 比較表：7天 vs 15天 vs 年度報告
blocks.en: 3.5 Comparison Table: 7-Day vs 15-Day vs Annual Report

blocks.zh: 比較表的記憶框架
blocks.en: A Memory Framework for the Comparison Table

blocks.zh: 三種報告機制的核心差異可以用一句話記憶：
blocks.en: The core differences among the three reporting mechanisms can be remembered in one sentence each:

blocks.zh: 7 天：「有人在死/要死了 → 立即報告」
blocks.en: 7-day: "Someone is dying or has died → report immediately"

blocks.zh: 15 天：「嚴重但非立即死亡的新發現 → 兩週內報告」
blocks.en: 15-day: "A serious new finding, but not immediately fatal → report within two weeks"

blocks.zh: 年度報告：「一年來所有安全資訊的總帳 → 週年後 60 天內交卷」
blocks.en: Annual report: "The full ledger of all safety information for the year → hand it in within 60 days after the anniversary"

blocks.zh: 另一個記憶重點：7 天和 15 天報告都需要同時通知 FDA + 所有研究員，而年度報告只送 FDA。這是因為快速安全報告的目的之一是讓前線研究員即時知道潛在安全風險，以保護目前正在入組中的受試者。
blocks.en: Another point to remember: both the 7-day and 15-day reports must be sent to FDA and all investigators, whereas the annual report goes to FDA only. This is because one purpose of expedited safety reports is to let frontline investigators know about potential safety risks immediately, so as to protect subjects currently being enrolled.

blocks.zh: SUSAR 三要件的灰色地帶
blocks.en: Gray Areas in the Three SUSAR Criteria

blocks.zh: 實務中最常發生爭議的情境：
blocks.en: Situations that most often cause disputes in practice:

blocks.zh: 「嚴重」vs「非嚴重」的邊界：「重要醫療事件（important medical event）」的認定具有主觀性。例如：嚴重低血糖需要靜脈注射葡萄糖但未住院 — 通常認定為「嚴重」，因為若未及時干預可能危及生命。
blocks.en: The boundary between "serious" and "non-serious": determining an "important medical event" is subjective. For example, severe hypoglycemia requiring intravenous glucose but no hospitalization is usually judged "serious", because it could become life-threatening without timely intervention.

blocks.zh: 「未預期」的更新時機：當申辦人決定更新 IB 以反映新認識到的不良反應時，更新後的 IB 使原先「未預期」的反應變成「預期」。但 IB 更新本身也必須通知 FDA（透過協議修改或資訊修改）。
blocks.en: When "unexpected" is updated: when the sponsor decides to update the IB to reflect a newly recognized adverse reaction, the updated IB turns a previously "unexpected" reaction into an "expected" one. But the IB update itself must also be notified to FDA (through a protocol amendment or an information amendment).

blocks.zh: 「疑似因果關係」的判斷分歧：研究員填報「可能無關（Unrelated）」，但申辦人醫學審查後認為無法排除因果關係 → 申辦人應按照「疑似」處理，提交報告，並在報告中說明兩方評估意見的差異。FDA 的立場是：有疑問時，報告優先。
blocks.en: Disagreement on "suspected" causality: the investigator records "Unrelated", but after medical review the sponsor concludes that a causal relationship cannot be ruled out → the sponsor should treat the event as "suspected", submit the report, and explain in it the difference between the two assessments. FDA's position is: when in doubt, report.

blocks.zh: SUSAR 判斷速查工具 SUSAR Quick Checker
blocks.en: SUSAR Quick Checker

blocks.zh:
事件是否導致：
  □ 死亡？
  □ 危及生命？
  □ 需住院（或延長住院）？
  □ 永久/重大殘疾？
  □ 先天畸形？
  □ 重要醫療事件（需醫療介入防止上述後果）？
→ 若任一勾選 = SERIOUS ✓

在研究員手冊（IB）中：
  □ 此類事件從未列出？
  □ 或列出但實際嚴重程度超出 IB 描述？
→ 若任一勾選 = UNEXPECTED ✓

是否有合理可能性為試驗藥品所致？
  □ 時間關聯性（給藥後合理時間內發生）？
  □ 生物合理性（藥理機制可解釋）？
  □ 停藥後改善（dechallenge positive）？
→ 若有合理可能 = SUSPECTED ✓

三項全部 ✓ → SUSAR → 進入時間軸判斷：
  Fatal/Life-threatening? → 7-DAY REPORT
  Other serious unexpected? → 15-DAY REPORT
blocks.en:
Did the event result in:
  □ Death?
  □ Life-threatening condition?
  □ Hospitalization (or prolonged hospitalization)?
  □ Persistent or significant disability?
  □ Congenital anomaly?
  □ Important medical event (requiring medical intervention to prevent the above outcomes)?
→ If any box is checked = SERIOUS ✓

In the Investigator's Brochure (IB):
  □ This type of event has never been listed?
  □ Or it is listed, but the actual severity exceeds the IB description?
→ If any box is checked = UNEXPECTED ✓

Is there a reasonable possibility that the investigational product caused it?
  □ Temporal relationship (occurred within a reasonable time after dosing)?
  □ Biological plausibility (explainable by the pharmacological mechanism)?
  □ Improvement after stopping the drug (dechallenge positive)?
→ If a reasonable possibility exists = SUSPECTED ✓

All three ✓ → SUSAR → proceed to the timeline decision:
  Fatal/Life-threatening? → 7-DAY REPORT
  Other serious unexpected? → 15-DAY REPORT

blocks.zh: 3.6 練習與應用 Practice & Application
blocks.en: 3.6 Practice & Application

blocks.zh: 練習一：報告類型分類 Classify the Report Type
blocks.en: Exercise 1: Classify the Report Type

blocks.zh: 請為以下每個情境分類：屬於 7 天報告、15 天報告，還是只需在年度報告中提及？
blocks.en: Classify each situation below: is it a 7-day report, a 15-day report, or only to be mentioned in the annual report?

blocks.zh: Phase 2 研究中，一位受試者在注射試驗藥品後第 3 天因急性肝衰竭住院，需要緊急肝臟移植評估。研究員評估為「可能相關（probably related）」。肝毒性在 IB 中僅列為「輕度、可逆性 ALT 上升」，從未提及急性肝衰竭。
blocks.en: In a Phase 2 study, a subject was hospitalized on day 3 after injection of the investigational product with acute liver failure and required urgent evaluation for liver transplant. The investigator assessed the event as "probably related". Hepatotoxicity is listed in the IB only as "mild, reversible ALT elevation", and acute liver failure is never mentioned.

blocks.zh: Phase 1 試驗中，一位受試者出現 Grade 2 噁心（需要藥物處置但未住院）。IB 中已明確列出噁心為常見不良反應（Grade 1-3）。
blocks.en: In a Phase 1 trial, a subject developed Grade 2 nausea (requiring drug treatment but not hospitalization). The IB clearly lists nausea as a common adverse reaction (Grade 1-3).

blocks.zh: 動物毒理研究新數據顯示高劑量組大鼠出現肝臟腺瘤，而目前 Phase 2 試驗的人體劑量為動物致癌劑量的 1/5。
blocks.en: New animal toxicology data show liver adenomas in high-dose rats, while the human dose in the current Phase 2 trial is 1/5 of the carcinogenic dose in animals.

blocks.zh: Phase 3 研究中，一位 73 歲女性受試者在第 8 週治療後死亡，死因初步判斷為心臟病發作（MI），已知她有高血壓和糖尿病病史。研究員認為與藥物「不太可能相關（unlikely related）」。IB 中無心血管事件記載。
blocks.en: In a Phase 3 study, a 73-year-old female subject died in week 8 of treatment; the preliminary cause of death was a heart attack (MI), and she had a known history of hypertension and diabetes. The investigator considered the event "unlikely related" to the drug. The IB contains no cardiovascular events.

blocks.zh: 練習一答案解析
blocks.en: Exercise 1: Answer Analysis

blocks.zh: 15 天報告（非 7 天，因「住院」是嚴重，但「需移植評估」尚非「危及生命（life-threatening）已確認」——若情況惡化至危及生命則升級為 7 天）。SERIOUS ✓（住院）+ UNEXPECTED ✓（急性肝衰竭超出 IB）+ SUSPECTED ✓（可能相關）= SUSAR → 15-day report
blocks.en: 15-day report (not 7-day, because "hospitalization" is serious, but "evaluation for transplant" does not yet confirm "life-threatening"; if the condition worsens to life-threatening, it escalates to a 7-day report). SERIOUS ✓ (hospitalization) + UNEXPECTED ✓ (acute liver failure exceeds the IB) + SUSPECTED ✓ (probably related) = SUSAR → 15-day report

blocks.zh: 年度報告。Grade 2 噁心：非 SAE（未住院、非危及生命）。SERIOUS ✗ → 不是 SUSAR，無需快速報告。
blocks.en: Annual report. Grade 2 nausea: not an SAE (no hospitalization, not life-threatening). SERIOUS ✗ → not a SUSAR; no expedited report is needed.

blocks.zh: 15 天報告（動物致癌性發現 = 「significant risk for human subjects」，按 §312.32(b)(3) 提交 15 天報告）
blocks.en: 15-day report (the animal carcinogenicity finding = "significant risk for human subjects"; submit a 15-day report under §312.32(b)(3))

blocks.zh: 15 天報告（可能有爭議，但保守立場適用）。死亡 = SERIOUS ✓。心臟病發作未在 IB 列出 = UNEXPECTED ✓。「Unlikely related」≠「不可能相關」——FDA 立場：只要不能完全排除因果關係，就仍屬 SUSPECTED ✓。有疑問時，報告優先。
blocks.en: 15-day report (arguable, but the conservative position applies). Death = SERIOUS ✓. Myocardial infarction not listed in the IB = UNEXPECTED ✓. "Unlikely related" ≠ "impossible": FDA's position is that as long as a causal relationship cannot be completely ruled out, the event is still SUSPECTED ✓. When in doubt, report.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用情境：內毒素 OOS — 從製造偏差到 IND 安全報告的完整流程
blocks.en: CDMO Application Scenario: Endotoxin OOS — The Full Process from Manufacturing Deviation to IND Safety Report

blocks.zh: 情境背景：
blocks.en: Background:

blocks.zh: 某 CDMO 正在為一家生物技術公司（申辦人）製造 Phase 2 臨床試驗用靜脈注射製劑。QC 部門在例行穩定性測試中發現：已放行並配送至臨床試驗機構的 3 個批次（批號：CT-2026-011, 012, 013），其中內毒素含量超出規格上限 2 倍（OOS 結果）。這 3 個批次已對共計 47 名受試者給藥，約有 12 名受試者仍在使用中。
blocks.en: A CDMO is manufacturing an intravenous product for a Phase 2 clinical trial for a biotech company (the sponsor). During routine stability testing, the QC department finds that for 3 batches already released and shipped to clinical sites (lots CT-2026-011, 012, 013), the endotoxin level exceeds the specification upper limit by 2 times (OOS result). These 3 batches have been administered to a total of 47 subjects, and about 12 subjects are still on treatment.

blocks.zh: 問題：
blocks.en: Questions:

blocks.zh: CDMO QC 部門發現 OOS 結果後，應立即採取哪些行動？
blocks.en: After the CDMO QC department finds the OOS result, what actions should it take immediately?

blocks.zh: CDMO 應向申辦人提供哪些具體資訊？
blocks.en: What specific information should the CDMO provide to the sponsor?

blocks.zh: 申辦人收到通知後，應進行哪些評估以決定是否需要提交 IND 安全報告？
blocks.en: After receiving the notification, what evaluations should the sponsor perform to decide whether an IND safety report is required?

blocks.zh: 若決定需要提交安全報告，適用 7 天還是 15 天報告？報告內容應包括哪些要素？
blocks.en: If a safety report is required, does the 7-day or 15-day timeline apply? What elements should the report include?

blocks.zh: 除安全報告外，申辦人是否還需提交其他類型的修改申請？
blocks.en: Besides the safety report, does the sponsor need to submit any other type of amendment?

blocks.zh: CDMO 情境完整解析
blocks.en: Full Analysis of the CDMO Scenario

blocks.zh: Step 1 — CDMO 立即行動（OOS 確認後 24 小時內）：
blocks.en: Step 1 — CDMO immediate actions (within 24 hours of OOS confirmation):

blocks.zh: 啟動 OOS 調查程序，確認結果是否為「真 OOS」（排除實驗誤差）
blocks.en: Start the OOS investigation procedure and confirm whether the result is a "true OOS" (excluding laboratory error)

blocks.zh: 立即通知申辦人（電話 + 書面確認），說明：哪些批次、OOS 數值、已給藥批次的配送/回收狀態
blocks.en: Notify the sponsor immediately (by phone + written confirmation), stating: which batches, the OOS values, and the shipping/recall status of the batches already administered

blocks.zh: 隔離所有相關批次（若仍有未使用存貨）
blocks.en: Quarantine all affected batches (if unused stock remains)

blocks.zh: 同步向 QA 通報，啟動偏差調查，保存所有原始記錄
blocks.en: Notify QA in parallel, start the deviation investigation, and preserve all raw records

blocks.zh: Step 2 — CDMO 提供給申辦人的資訊清單：
blocks.en: Step 2 — Information the CDMO provides to the sponsor:

blocks.zh: OOS 批次的批號、製造日期、配送日期、配送地點
blocks.en: Lot numbers, manufacturing dates, shipping dates and shipping destinations of the OOS batches

blocks.zh: 具體 OOS 測試結果（測試日期、測試方法、規格上下限、實測值）
blocks.en: The specific OOS test results (test date, test method, upper and lower specification limits, measured value)

blocks.zh: 初步根因評估（製程、原料、測試方法、設備問題）
blocks.en: Preliminary root cause assessment (process, raw materials, test method, equipment issues)

blocks.zh: 已給藥受試者數量（如可知）
blocks.en: Number of subjects dosed (if known)

blocks.zh: 相關批次製造記錄（Batch Record）摘要
blocks.en: Summary of the relevant batch manufacturing records (Batch Record)

blocks.zh: 任何類似歷史偏差記錄（趨勢分析）
blocks.en: Any similar historical deviation records (trend analysis)

blocks.zh: Step 3 — 申辦人安全評估（決定是否觸發 IND 安全報告）：
blocks.en: Step 3 — Sponsor safety assessment (deciding whether an IND safety report is triggered):

blocks.zh: 內毒素超標 2 倍的臨床風險評估：靜脈注射製劑中內毒素可直接引起發熱反應（Pyrogenic Reaction）、嚴重時引起膿毒性休克（Septic Shock）
blocks.en: Clinical risk assessment of endotoxin at 2 times the limit: in an intravenous product, endotoxin can directly cause a pyrogenic reaction and, in severe cases, septic shock

blocks.zh: 查詢 47 名受試者中是否有不明原因的發熱反應、寒顫、低血壓報告，特別是給藥後 1-4 小時內的不良事件
blocks.en: Check whether any of the 47 subjects have reports of unexplained fever, chills or hypotension, especially adverse events within 1-4 hours after dosing

blocks.zh: 評估「unexpected」：內毒素相關的系統性發炎反應是否已列於 IB？通常未針對製造污染導致的內毒素反應進行說明
blocks.en: Assess "unexpected": is endotoxin-related systemic inflammatory response listed in the IB? Typically, endotoxin reactions caused by manufacturing contamination are not described

blocks.zh: Step 4 — 報告類型判定：
blocks.en: Step 4 — Determining the report type:

blocks.zh: 若調查發現任何受試者出現發熱性反應或更嚴重事件（住院、低血壓）且與給藥時間相關：→ 15 天 IND 安全報告（SAE + Unexpected + Suspected）
blocks.en: If the investigation finds any subject with a febrile reaction or a more serious event (hospitalization, hypotension) related in time to dosing: → 15-day IND safety report (SAE + Unexpected + Suspected)

blocks.zh: 若調查發現受試者出現危及生命的嚴重膿毒症反應：→ 7 天 IND 安全報告
blocks.en: If the investigation finds a subject with a life-threatening severe septic reaction: → 7-day IND safety report

blocks.zh: 即使目前無症狀：→ 申辦人應至少提交資訊修改（§312.31）報告 CMC OOS 問題，並評估是否需要修改入組/給藥計畫（可能需要協議修改）
blocks.en: Even if there are no symptoms at present: → the sponsor should at least submit an information amendment (§312.31) reporting the CMC OOS issue, and evaluate whether the enrollment/dosing plan needs to be changed (a protocol amendment may be required)

blocks.zh: Step 5 — 其他必要申請：
blocks.en: Step 5 — Other required submissions:

blocks.zh: §312.31 資訊修改：OOS 製造發現 → CMC 資訊修改（30 天內）
blocks.en: §312.31 information amendment: OOS manufacturing finding → CMC information amendment (within 30 days)

blocks.zh: §312.30 協議修改：若決定停用受影響批次並修改試驗程序，需提交協議修改
blocks.en: §312.30 protocol amendment: if it is decided to stop using the affected batches and modify the study procedures, a protocol amendment must be submitted

blocks.zh: 考慮主動向 FDA 申請討論（Pre-Meeting Request）評估是否需要 Clinical Hold
blocks.en: Consider proactively requesting a discussion with FDA (Pre-Meeting Request) to assess whether a clinical hold is needed

blocks.zh: 通知所有研究員（主動聯繫各中心，確認受試者狀況）
blocks.en: Notify all investigators (proactively contact each site to confirm the condition of the subjects)

blocks.zh: 關鍵教訓： CDMO 的職責在 Step 1 和 Step 2。申辦人的職責從 Step 3 開始。兩者的溝通速度和資訊完整性，直接決定了申辦人能否在法定期限內完成安全評估並遞交報告。
blocks.en: Key lesson: the CDMO's responsibilities lie in Step 1 and Step 2. The sponsor's responsibilities begin at Step 3. The speed and completeness of communication between the two directly determine whether the sponsor can complete the safety assessment and submit the report within the statutory deadline.

blocks.zh: 本章核心要點總結 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 合規風險最高點 Highest Compliance Risk:
blocks.en: Highest Compliance Risk:

blocks.zh: §312.32 的 7 天報告是整個 IND 申辦人義務體系中後果最嚴重的條款。未在 7 天內報告致死或危及生命的 SUSAR，可能直接導致 Clinical Hold（臨床暫停令），終止所有正在進行的研究，對藥物開發計畫造成毀滅性影響。對 CDMO 而言，最直接的責任是確保不良製造事件「立即、完整地」通知申辦人，不得以「等待 OOS 調查完成」為由延遲通知。
blocks.en: The 7-day report under §312.32 is the provision with the most serious consequences in the entire IND sponsor obligation framework. Failing to report a fatal or life-threatening SUSAR within 7 days can directly lead to a clinical hold, halting all ongoing studies and devastating the drug development program. For a CDMO, the most direct responsibility is to ensure that adverse manufacturing events are notified to the sponsor "immediately and completely", and notification must never be delayed on the grounds of "waiting for the OOS investigation to finish".
